g.text: Loads the snapshot or the AOF
Once the loop stops: waits for the
keyspace thread, then the final save
Run io_.run() with the main thread
Accept loop, signal wait, cron timer
each on a strand of its own
Executes every batch, one at a time
fsyncs the log once a second;
One writer: the thread that runs commands.
Readers: the watchdog, and the crash handler,
A work guard keeps io_.run() going
until serve() stops the loop itself:
at shutdown serve() still waits for the
watchdog, which is no work of io_'s.
